name: How long does a typical kitchen lighting upgrade take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen lighting upgrade take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen lighting upgrade depends on the complexity of the project. Simple fixture replacements can often be completed in a single day. More involved projects, such as adding new recessed lighting, installing new electrical circuits, or integrating smart lighting systems, might take anywhere from 2 to 5 days. For larger remodels that include lighting as part of a broader kitchen renovation, the timeline will align with the overall project schedule. We provide a clear timeline estimate during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple upgrades may take a day, while more complex projects involving new wiring or fixtures can take 2-5 days or more, depending on scope.
